comparison_intro: One behavior contract, three implementations. Run the companion files and the same three acceptance tests against shared fixture data.

language_notes.sas: Input fields have width 8 and both outputs width 24. CAT preserves blanks; CATX trims outer blanks and skips blank fields.
language_notes.python: catx_space helper in reference.py strips ordinary spaces, drops blank parts and joins with one space. It does not trim CAT.
language_notes.r: catx_space helper in reference.R uses trimws(..., whitespace=" "), removes empty parts, then paste(..., collapse=" ").

semantic_notes.title: CAT and CATX have different jobs
semantic_notes.text: CAT joins the three padded fields exactly. CATX trims ordinary outer spaces, omits blank fields and inserts one separator between retained fields.

semantic_notes.title: Missing belongs to input decoding
semantic_notes.text: CSV blank fields represent the original missing character values. Original unquoted input periods are decoded before translation; stored text is not blindly cleaned.

tests.name: Original three-row fixture
tests.expected: Exact CAT strings preserve 8+8+8 positions; padded CATX values read John Q Public, Jane Doe and Bob Smith.
tests.catches: Dropping CAT padding, inserting separators for blank middle fields, or changing the readable CATX names.

tests.name: Added blank/space boundary
tests.input: Added outer spaces, all blank fields, internal space Mary Ann, and literal tabs.
tests.expected: CAT preserves all stored positions; CATX omits empty fields and retains internal spaces and tabs.
tests.catches: Broad whitespace stripping, doubled separators, or treating an all-blank CATX result as missing numeric data.

tests.name: Preservation, widths and order
tests.input: All shared rows reversed; original caller data saved.
tests.expected: Caller unchanged; input widths 8 and output widths 24; exact stored values and row order retained.
tests.catches: Readable-name-only checks, missing output padding, input mutation or row reordering.

scope: ASCII character fields at most 8 positions; results fit width 24. CSV inputs are already decoded, with blanks for character missing. No numeric CAT coercion, overflow or Unicode equivalence claim.
